operators.name: triu_last2d
semantics: Applies torch.triu to the last two dimensions of the input tensor (height x width matrix) for each batch and channel.
Elements below the main diagonal (i > j) are set to 0; other elements remain unchanged.
Input and output have identical shape, dtype, and device.
Preserves input strides and memory layout as returned by torch.triu, which may be non-contiguous.

operators.name: conv2d

returns.shape: [batch, out_channels, output_height, output_width] where output_height = floor((height + 2*padding[0] - dilation[0]*(kernel_height-1) - 1)/stride[0]) + 1 and similarly for width

semantics: Performs 2D convolution as in the reference nn.Conv2d module.
Uses weight from the conv2d layer; no bias is used (bias=False in reference).
stride, padding, and dilation are fixed at (1,1), (1,2), and (2,1) respectively, matching the reference configuration.
Implementation must use cuDNN for convolution, as required by the task.
Input may be non-contiguous; handle strides appropriately or make contiguous internally.
Applies upper triangular mask on last two dimensions: for each batch and channel, element (i,j) is kept if i <= j, else set to 0.
Output shape and dtype identical to input.
Applies Conv2d with weight shape [64,3,3,5], stride (1,1), padding (1,2), dilation (2,1), bias=False.
Output shape [batch,64, output_height, output_width] where output_height = floor((256 + 2*1 - 2*(3-1) - 1)/1) + 1 = 254, output_width = floor((512 + 2*2 - 1*(5-1) - 1)/1) + 1 = 512.
